Name: Not You Again
Author: tiakall
Description:
This mod adds the most loveable and desired of fish from the Animal Crossing series, the Sea Bass, to Stardew.  It's not worth very much, Willy hates it, and it only makes roe in a fish pond, but hey, it looks cute in your fish tank.

Update 1.1: Now has animation support thanks to the master of animation, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/24986819]Gervig91[/url]!  Can be toggled on or off in the config.json, default is true.

Update 2.0: [b]MEME HARDER

[/b]So in the most recent Animal Crossing, when you donate a sea bass, Blathers mentions:

[i]"[i]"Sea bass" is a bit pedestrian, though. Many species have better names, such as "redbanded perch." Or the delightfully whimsical dusky
grouper! Or the potato cod! WILL NO ONE THINK OF THE PINK MAOMAO?!"[/i]"

[/i]Guys, gals, and nonbinary pals... we have thought of the pink maomao.

This update adds four fish: the dusky grouper, the pink maomao, the potato cod, and the redbanded perch.  The dusky grouper and redbanded perch are catchable on the Pelican Town beach while the pink maomao and potato cod are catchable on Ginger Island.  All seasons, all weather. Unlike the pedestrian sea bass, a few people do love these fish.  Currently they do not have fish pond data, so they will only produce basic roe when put in a pond--if I have some clever pond ideas later, I may update again.

Update 3.0: The 1.6ening

Not You Again is now fully 1.6 compatible and entirely in CP! No more weird spawning tricks! No more aquarium overlaps! No more JA!  Balanced prices is now a config instead of a separate file.  Also, I had some clever pond ideas, so they now have unique fish pond spawns + some surprises.



Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657]Lemurkat[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url]﻿ for walking the clueless newbie (me) through the CP parts.

Don't like my art? [s]How dare you[/s] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/92060238]Taiyokun[/url] has done a reskin of the Sea Bass in his [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8980]Expansion Fish Redesign mod[/url].

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8897]Visible Fish mod[/url] is the genius work of shekurika.

Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/114762643?tab=user+files]CopperSun[/url] for making the maths go brrrrr and creating a more balanced version.
